member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Rhi.RhiBackdrop
member.summary: The blurred copies of this frame's scene that frosted glass samples, from least to most blurred.
member.remarks: The host fills it once per frame from the device's backdrop blur, after the 3D scene and before the interface. A glass panel asking for a blur between two levels draws the sharper one and cross-fades the blurrier one over it, so an animated blur radius moves smoothly instead of stepping.

member.name: T:OpenIGI.UI.Rhi.RhiUiRenderer
member.summary: The game's : every quad and glyph the painter emits goes straight into the engine's open , in submission order.

remarks.para: A thin adapter by design — it holds no state between frames and allocates nothing per draw, so the game can wrap its batch in one every frame. A quad maps onto one-to-one; a glyph onto the distance-field path when its font is a field (or effects are asked for), else onto a plain textured quad, exactly as the painter drew before it had a seam.
Frosted glass samples , the blurred pyramid of the scene the host captured this frame. Without one the glass is its tint alone.
